title: Career Roadmap · Aanganwadi Worker
summary: An Anganwadi Worker supports young children’s nutrition, preschool learning, growth monitoring and community-level maternal and child health services through India’s Anganwadi system under Mission Saksham Anganwadi and POSHAN 2.0.

facts.Course: Diploma - Elementary / Early Childhood Education (D.El.Ed, NTT)

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Meet state-specific eligibility → Apply for an advertised Anganwadi Worker vacancy → Selection and document verification → Induction training → Community service.

blocks.label: Education
blocks.text: Eligibility is determined by the relevant state / Union Territory recruitment notification; do not assume Class 12 or a diploma is universally required.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Regional language, English, child development, nutrition and basic mathematics.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Preschool activities, nutrition awareness, community outreach and child growth monitoring.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Communication, record keeping, teamwork, empathy and digital literacy.

blocks.label: Recruitment
blocks.text: Follow the relevant Women and Child Development Department / district notification.

items.text: ECCE / NTT → Useful for preschool activities; not a universal requirement for Anganwadi Worker recruitment.
D.El.Ed. → Relevant to elementary-school teaching; not automatically required for Anganwadi posts.
Nutrition / child-development training → Can strengthen practical knowledge, subject to recruitment relevance.
Government induction and refresher training → Follow the training prescribed by the responsible department after selection.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Anganwadi Worker is a scheme-based community post, not the same as a regular school-teacher post. Recruitment eligibility, age limits, residence requirements, merit criteria and selection methods vary by state and notification.

blocks.label: Induction
blocks.text: Anganwadi duties, child safety, nutrition and community engagement.

blocks.label: Daily practice
blocks.text: Preschool activities, beneficiary records, growth monitoring and home visits as assigned.

blocks.text: Learn approved POSHAN Tracker workflows and data entry.

blocks.label: Practical projects
blocks.text: Weekly preschool activity calendar; nutrition-awareness session; child-growth record review; community outreach plan.

blocks.text: Anganwadi Centres, health outreach activities and approved community programmes.

blocks.label: Partner organisations
blocks.text: NGOs and community organisations working on child nutrition, early learning and maternal-child support.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: ECCE activities, nutrition awareness, record management and family engagement.
Volunteer or placement opportunities must be arranged with the relevant authority; they do not guarantee recruitment.

blocks.label: Alternative route
blocks.text: Anganwadi Helper / related eligible post → Apply for Worker promotion when permitted by state rules.

blocks.label: Progression route
blocks.text: Experienced Worker → Supervisor / other departmental post, only when eligible and selected under applicable rules.

blocks.label: Typical route
Important
blocks.text: Anganwadi Worker is an India-specific role. Overseas employers may require different qualifications, safeguarding checks, work authorization and professional registration. Employment or visa sponsorship is not guaranteed.
Eligible Applicant ↓ Anganwadi Worker Trainee / Induction ↓ Anganwadi Worker ↓ Experienced Worker ↓ Eligible Supervisor / Departmental Role ↓ Community Child Development / Programme Coordination
Progression depends on vacancies, service rules, qualifications and selection.

MEET STATE RECRUITMENT ELIGIBILITY ↓ APPLY FOR OFFICIAL ANGANWADI VACANCY ↓ SELECTION + DOCUMENT VERIFICATION ↓ INDUCTION + FIELD TRAINING ↓ ANGANWADI WORKER ↓ ECCE + NUTRITION + DIGITAL SKILLS ↓ EXPERIENCE + ELIGIBLE PROMOTION / FURTHER STUDY
